summary: Part-DB: PHP/Symfony electronic-component inventory management system with parts, stock lots, categories/footprints/manufacturers/suppliers/storage locations (hierarchical structural elements), prices/orderdetails, projects + BOM, users/groups/permissions/2FA, attachments, event log, labels and info-provider import; persisted in MySQL/SQLite/Postgres via Doctrine; exposes REST (API Platform) + MCP tools.
